Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1204 of 2022

Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Mittal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Brij Lal Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Pankaj Baranwal, Advocate holding brief of Sri Brij Lal Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Suresh Bahadur Singh, learned A.G.A. Ist for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 981 of 2017, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 120B, 34 I.P.C. 3, 4, 5, 6 of the Prize Chits and Money Circulation Scheme (Banning) Act, 1978,, Police Station- Kavinagar, District- Ghaziabad during pendency of the trial in the court below.

sentences.text: First information report of the present case was lodged on 03.07.2017 under Section 420 IPC against M/s Ablaze Info Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and its Director, Abhinav Mittal and one another and as per allegation, on the inducement of Abhinav Mittal, the Director of the Firm, applicant invested Rs.57,500/- in M/s Ablaze Info Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and his entire amount was misappropriated by the Company.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant was not named in the first information report and during investigation when it was revealed that applicant was also one of the Directors of M/s Ablaze Info Solutions Pvt. Ltd. then only due to this reason he was made accused in the present Sunil Kumar Mittal vs State Of U.P. on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160982165/

sentences.text: He further submitted that admittedly applicant neither induced the informant nor any money was transferred in his account.
He further submitted that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 05.04.2017 i.e. for last more than five and half years.

He further submitted that although applicant is having criminal history of 57 other cases but in all 57 cases, he has been made accused merely on the basis of fact that he was one of the Directors of the abovenoted company and in number of cases, he has already been released on bail.
Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the factual arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of case.

It appears that during investigation applicant was made accused in the present matter due to the reason that he was one of the Directors of M/s Ablaze Info Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and admittedly, he neither induced informant nor any money was transferred in his account.
Although applicant is having criminal history of 57 other cases but in all 57 cases, applicant has been made accused merely on the ground that he was one of the Directors of the alleged company.
Applicant is in jail since 05.04.2017 i.e. for last about more than five and half years.
Therefore, in view of the discussion made above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant - Sunil Kumar Mittal be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 20.2.2023 Aditya  Sunil Kumar Mittal vs State Of U.P. on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160982165/
